notes: Wald's Part I numerical example (Wald 1943, CRC 432 reprint 1980). Confirmed from the sources reachable here: 400 planes, 380 return, 20 downed, 320 returning with no hit (a0 = .800), 32 with one (a1 = .080), 20 with two (a2 = .050), at most five hits (n = 5), root q = .851, p = .149. The split 4 / 2 / 2 for three, four and five hits (a3 = .010, a4 = .005, a5 = .005) is reconstructed from the memo's polynomial fragments and is the only split that reproduces q = .851 (claim c-q). On screen it appears only as '8 with 3 to 5 holes', which is the subtraction 60 - 32 - 20 and holds whatever the split. 'guess' is the film-mode default commit (film.json defaultGuess), not a fact.

claims.formula: (function(){var a=[a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5];var f=function(q){var s=0;for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++){s+=a[i]/Math.pow(q,i);}return s-1;};var lo=0.5,hi=0.9999;for(var k=0;k<200;k++){var m=(lo+hi)/2;if(f(m)>0){lo=m;}else{hi=m;}}return Math.round(lo*1000)/1000;})()
claims.where: try-it panel and sources note only (cross-check that the reconstructed 4 / 2 / 2 split reproduces the memo)

claims.formula: (function(){var a=[a0,a1,a2,a3,a4,a5];var f=function(q){var s=0;for(var i=0;i<a.length;i++){s+=a[i]/Math.pow(q,i);}return s-1;};var lo=0.5,hi=0.9999;for(var k=0;k<200;k++){var m=(lo+hi)/2;if(f(m)>0){lo=m;}else{hi=m;}}return Math.round((1-lo)*1000)/1000;})()
